notes.title: BACK FROM SUMMER!
notes.content: [p]We're back, with a thrilling amount of energy after a good rest in our summer crypts, and dives straight into development again! [/p][p]A massive [b]thank you[/b] to all of you who braved our demo, your screams, laughter combined with all your feedback has become the beating heart of this project, and made our board games truly come alive. [/p][p]Your words has been the silver bullets we needed to keep the mental monsters away. [/p][p]We’ve gathered up everything you’ve told us, and a round of fixes and improvements will rise to the surface when the time is right. [/p][p][/p][h3]With that said, a little sneak peak on what's to come: [/h3][list][*][p][b]A brand new board[/b] is being brewed in our cauldrons, and this one might be a little bit more salty than the first one,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Abilities[/b] are on their way in, which will give the board a completely new level of planning, deceit and (hopefully) laughter with their game changing power-ups.,[/p][/*][*][p][b]A whole lot of tweaks + stability fixes[/b] to help more players to play the game without having to do an error-check through every time.,[/p][/*][/list][p]And don’t wander too far… we’ll also be part of [b]Scream Fest[/b] this fall! Keep your flashlight handy for spooky showcases and updates.  [/p][p]Thanks again for playing, testing, and sharing your screams with us. Together, we’re making Board Game Society the ultimate 80s horror board game fever dream.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063685/b74f83dda7e716b371d2d90d6da7e716919fa377.png"][/img][/p][p]Stay spooky, [/p][p]// Jetebra Games[/p]

notes.title: SUMMER BREAK & TELEPORTATION
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We just wanted to send out a massive [b]THANK YOU[/b] to all of you who played the demo for [b]Board Game Society[/b] during the festival! It’s been incredible seeing so many of you explore the cursed forest, throw dice at monsters, and yell at your friends during chaotic events. The feedback, the kind words, the bug reports, and the chaos you've shared with us have meant the world.[/p][p]We're pushing out an update today that includes a ton of [b]bugfixes[/b], [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b], and [b]balance tweaks[/b] based on what you've told us. It’s all live now, so if you have some time over to explore the demo once more, you'll hopefully find something new to experience.[/p][p][/p][p]With all that said, the team at Jetebra Games is taking a [b]well-earned break[/b] for the month of July to rest and recharge a bit. That means we might be a little slower than usual to respond to messages, posts, or feedback. But please [b]keep sending it![/b] We’re reading everything — even if we’re doing it in sunglasses on a beach somewhere.[/p][p][/p][h3]You can send us feedback through:[/h3][list][*][p]Our Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/wGF6UQt3gU"]https://discord.gg/wGF6UQt3gU[/url][/p][/*][*][p]The Steam Community Hub[/p][/*][*][p]Our Google Form: [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScp7grGd1-nPbKLOv-kpMmHkjtfgxG3zMuCZLOeILQ0KHr5oA/viewform?usp=dialog"]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScp7grGd1-nPbKLOv-kpMmHkjtfgxG3zMuCZLOeILQ0KHr5oA/viewform?usp=dialog[/url][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]So what is new in this update? [/h3][p]New Feature: Teleporters[/p][list][*][p]Teleporters are now up and running! Fast-travel your way through the cursed forest — if you find one, that is.[/p][/*][*][p]Fully functional and integrated into the board flow.[/p][/*][/list][p]New Feature: Top-Down Camera Mode[/p][list][*][p]A new top-down camera has been added! You can now view the board from a classic strategy angle.[/p][/*][*][p]It automatically follows the current player and makes movement and planning much clearer.[/p][/*][/list][p]Gameplay Fixes & Improvements[/p][list][*][p]Reworked crystals to properly show what item they contain.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed loot bug where arrows weren’t displayed correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved reliability when switching active players (no more double-jumps).[/p][/*][*][p]Molotov damage now correctly shows in encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Player log now shows when someone finds a crystal.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where multiple players on the same tile caused outdated monster cards and UI glitches.[/p][/*][/list][p]General[/p][list][*][p]Various UI elements updated to the latest style variant.[/p][/*][*][p]Continued work on shrinking the game build size without losing quality.
[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll be back in full force soon, and your thoughts will help shape what comes next. Thanks again for playing [b]BGS[/b], and we hope the forest hasn't claimed [i]too[/i] many of you...[/p][p]Stay spooky,
[b]Jetebra Games[/b][/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Thank You for Playing Our Demo During Steam Next Fest! 🎉
notes.content: [p]We just wanted to say a huge thank you to everyone who played our demo during Steam Next Fest! Your support, enthusiasm, and feedback have meant the world to us. [/p][p]Thanks to your help, we've been able to track down and fix a ton of bugs, and we’ve made several improvements based on your suggestions. Whether you reported a sneaky glitch or shared your thoughts on how the game feels, we appreciate every bit of it![/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s New?[/b][/p][p]Tons of bug fixes, including:[/p][list][*][p]Cards not flipping properly[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Volume slider now actually changes volume... insane.[/p][/*][*][p]The 30 FPS cap bug is gone — and you can now set your own frame rate in settings[/p][/*][*][p] You’ll now get to choose which item to keep when your inventory is full.[/p][/*][*][p]Medkits now actually heal you, and not just remove the button.[/p][/*][*][p]PvP extra damage texts is now functional — and no more wall of text explosions when it triggers.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Performance and stability improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]General balance tweaks and polish based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]A fresh version of the demo is now live, so if you haven’t tried it yet, or you’re curious about what’s changed, now’s the perfect time to check it out again.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re continuing to push forward with the full game, and we’ll keep sharing updates as we go. If you haven’t already, dropping a wishlist really helps us out and keeps you in the loop.[/p][p]Thanks again for being a part of this with us. It means a lot.[/p][p][/p][p]// Jetebra Games[/p]

notes.title: Demo Timer Removed – You Asked, We Listened!
notes.content:
[h2][b]The demo timer is gone. For good.[/b][/h2][p]A lot of players asked for it, and we totally get it — a timer in a board game doesn’t exactly scream "chill time with your friends" So we went back, looked at the feedback, and said "screw that"[/p][p]No more countdown. No more pressure. You can try [i]Board Game Society[/i] as much as you like, whenever you like. Whether you're solo testing mechanics or pulling a friend in for a match, it's all fully available, no strings attached.[/p][p]So feel free to explore the board, find little secrets, and experience an early snippet of what's to come. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Thanks for all the feedback, now give us even more![/b][/h2][p]We’re incredibly grateful for everyone who took the time to play and share their thoughts. It really helps shape where we go next. And to make it even easier, we've added a [b]FEEDBACK[/b] button in the pause menu, while playing the game so you can quickly and easily give us your feedback on the go. [/p][p][/p][p]Give it another go if you’ve been waiting — or tell a friend that the time limit’s no longer a thing.[/p][p]Thanks again for being part of this with us.
[b]– The Jetebra Games team[/b][/p]

notes.title: We Want To Hear Your Ideas!
notes.content: [h2]Hi Everyone![/h2][p]We’re thrilled to share the first public demo of Board Game Society with you during Steam Next Fest! 🎉[/p][p]This is a big milestone for us, and we can’t wait to hear what you think.[/p][p][/p][h2]🎲 Tried the demo? Help shape the game![/h2][p]We’re looking for [i]your[/i] thoughts, ideas, and bug reports. [/p][p]Whether it’s a clever mechanic you loved or something that felt off. [/p][p]We want to know.[/p][p][/p][h2]💬 Best way to reach us? Join our Discord![/h2][p]That’s where we’re most active, and you’ll get the [i]fastest replies[/i]. [/p][p]Plus, it’s a great place to chat with fellow fans and follow our development journey.[/p][p]Additionally, you can also use the voice channels to play with voiceover.[/p][p][/p][h2][b][url="https://discord.gg/2k3Hx4NmHa" style="button" buttoncolor="#6428bd"]Join our Discord[/url][/b][/h2][p][/p][h2]👉 Second best way? Steam Discussions![/h2][p]You can also post in the Steam Discussions if you prefer, [/p][p]just know it might take us a bit longer to reply there.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being part of this first step with us. [/p][p]We’re so excited to see your reactions![/p][p][/p][p]// Jetebra Games [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063685/ed4aae3d6a986521a1406f3eeb10584da42a825f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]
